mutation.description: Let every bonded sender set the staleness clock; the live-weight-set witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: The finality gate's partition is the live weight set; an outlier proposer outside the live weight must not set the staleness clock.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation makes the same test fail.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; not a historical replay or a coordinated rollout.

mutation.description: Disable the H-1 insert check; the equivocation witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: An equivocating block is refused at insert (H-1). The store-restore arm (H1c) is a sibling test, not this witness.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation admits the equivocating block and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness for the insert arm; the restore arm and a live rollout remain separate.

mutation.description: Accept every deploy signature; the forged-deploy witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: The block path verifies every deploy's signature; a deploy not signed by its named key is refused.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation removes the check and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; no historical replay or client rollout is claimed.

mutation.description: Skip the offender's signature re-check; the signed-conflict witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: Equivocation evidence is proved only by a signed conflict; an unsigned or wrongly signed proof is refused.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation accepts the unproved evidence and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness for the proof check; wire carriage and a live restart remain separate.

mutation.description: Skip failed parents in the height maximum; the failed-parent witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: The height maximum counts failed justifications; a failed parent still sets the child's bound.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation reintroduces the skip and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the historical fork-point rollout is separate.

mutation.description: Accept every block number (both the descent bound and the height maximum); the H1b witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: A resolved parent at or above the block's number is refused (H1b), failed parents included.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation admits the block and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the historical replay and rollout remain separate.

mutation.before: if max_number_of_parents <= 0 || b.justifications.len() as u128 <= max_number_of_parents as u128
mutation.after: if max_number_of_parents <= 0 || (b.justifications.len() as u128) < max_number_of_parents as u128
mutation.description: Change the parent bound from at-most to fewer-than; the over-limit witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: A block's justification set is bounded by max-number-of-parents and refused on the receiving side.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation admits one extra parent and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the committed-bound rollout is a separate release obligation.

mutation.description: Compare counts instead of sender sets; the non-bonded-sender witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: The minimum-message sender set must equal the bonded set, not merely match its size.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation accepts a non-bonded sender and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the live finality campaign is separate.

mutation.description: Require equality instead of containment; the non-live-seer witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: The full-partition filter is containment, not equality: a seer outside the partition does not invalidate support.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation rejects the containing seer set and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the partition campaign is separate.

mutation.description: Treat exactly two thirds as a supermajority; the boundary-corpus witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: The supermajority predicate is the exact integer 3*stake > 2*total; equality is not a supermajority.
entries.result_note: The named corpus test passes on the current build; the mutation flips the exact-boundary case and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the live N=8 finality campaign is separate (TA-C1).

mutation.description: Make the header time a validity input; the timestamp-independence witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: The parent-relative timestamp bound is retired; header time is informational and must not change a verdict.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the injected stamp-0 refusal changes the verdict and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the old/new validator comparison and coordinated activation remain release obligations.

mutation.description: Drop the committed fee floor; the genesis-params witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: The fee floor and parent bound are committed in the genesis params, not only in node config.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation makes the differing floors encode identically and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the genesis-hash/config/restore acceptance is a release obligation.

mutation.description: Stop inserting the configured multisig keys; the trusted-set witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: The Coop multisig public keys are read into the genesis trusted stakeholder set alongside the bond holders.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation leaves the multisig key out and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the governance ceremony and key custody are separate.

mutation.description: Drop the slashable flag from the proto encoding; the round-trip witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: The node's block metadata carries the slashable flag (proto field 22); it must survive the store round trip.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation loses the flag and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; it does not replay historical block metadata.

mutation.description: Treat every validator as inside the participation grace; the play/replay boundary witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: A boundary's participation comes from the last finalised fringe; the participation map reaches play and replay arithmetic alike.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation removes the participation difference and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the live boundary campaign is a release obligation.

mutation.description: Withhold the whole participation share; the absence-rule witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: A validator's epoch reward is scaled by its participation; the absence slack is the knee and the grace the recovery edge.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation removes the full share and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the historical replay and rollout are separate.

mutation.description: Pay the producer nothing; the executor-share witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: The block's producer is paid a share of what its deploys burned, sized by executor_share.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation zeroes the share and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the live reward campaign is separate.

mutation.description: Pay a delegator's remainder to the validator; the fan-out witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: A slash fans the untaken remainder out to each delegator's own vault and clears the delegation ledgers, at every tier.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation redirects the delegator share and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the live slashing campaign is separate.

mutation.description: Leave a slashed validator in the pending-withdrawal map; the persistence witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: A slashed validator that had a staged withdrawal is removed from the pending map.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation leaves the pending entry and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the live slashing campaign is separate.

mutation.description: Replace instead of accumulate a second delegation; the aggregate-bond witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: A validator's bond may be other people's stake: pos:bonds carries the aggregate and pos:delegations attributes it.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation burns the earlier principal and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the live delegation campaign is separate.

mutation.description: Pay the whole epoch reward to the operator; the delegated-reward witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: An epoch's reward for a key with delegators is split pro-rata, and a delegator's share is credited to pos:delegated_rewards.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation empties the delegated split and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the live reward campaign is separate.

mutation.description: Fund the pot without debiting the caller; the fundPot witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: fundPot adds REV to the validators' reward pot with no claim, debiting the caller's own vault.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation skips the debit and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the live governance campaign is separate.

mutation.description: Make the vault deposit callable; the deployer-capability witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: Vaults are a balance map keyed by REV address; transfer uses the caller's deployerId and an unauthenticated deposit is refused.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation accepts the mint path and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the wallet release campaign is separate.

mutation.description: Allow a withdrawal while delegations are outstanding; the mutual-exclusion witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: withdraw refuses while delegations are outstanding, and delegate refuses while a withdrawal is pending.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation allows the withdrawal and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the live staking campaign is separate.

mutation.description: Accept a negative NonNegI64; the refinement witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: bonds_map/stake are carried as NonNegI64; a negative stake is refused by the carrier, not clamped.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation accepts the negative and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the genesis-hash acceptance is separate.

mutation.description: Grade a Misdemeanour as Malicious; the tier witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: A slash is graded by the offence; the existing witness takes the worst tier and prices a Misdemeanour at a quarter.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation prices the tier as the whole bond and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness for the Misdemeanour tier; the other tier constants are the same table and the live campaign is separate.

mutation.description: Make the active-set draw uniform; the stake-weight witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: The active validator set is a stake-weighted draw without replacement, seeded from the epoch.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation makes the draw per-key uniform and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; the live active-set campaign is separate.

mutation.description: Leave the zero epoch unnormalised; the every-block-boundary witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: Epoch length 0 (the permissive default) means every block is an epoch boundary.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation makes the divisor zero and the same test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: A current-build regression witness; a live epoch campaign is separate.

mutation.description: Disable the liveness jail; the in-process liveness witness must fail.

entries.scope_note: The named liveness artifact runs the current build's in-process jail rule: a sustained absence jails without touching the bond.
entries.result_note: The named test passes on the current build; the mutation disables the jail and the inner test fails.
entries.does_not_claim: The in-process jail rule only. The devnet/partition arms of tools/liveness-enforcement-drill.py and the live G428-M4 campaign are release obligations.
